mainEntity.name: Copyfy ou Kalodata : lequel est le meilleur ?

acceptedAnswer.text: It all depends on your need. Copyfy is better for running an e-commerce business from A to Z across several platforms: product research, store analysis, product pages and visual import to Shopify. Kalodata is better if you sell only on TikTok Shop and want very deep data on that platform. For multi-channel dropshipping, Copyfy wins; for pure TikTok Shop, Kalodata stays solid.

mainEntity.name: Kalodata est-il moins cher que Copyfy ?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Copyfy starts at 49€/month with a free trial, while Kalodata charges its base plan from $45.90/month ($38.30/month annually). Kalodata's professional plan climbs to $99.90/month. At comparable features, Copyfy stays the most affordable.

mainEntity.name: Lequel a la meilleure recherche de produits ?

acceptedAnswer.text: Copyfy for platform diversity: its AI analyzes Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and other channels, and studies competitor stores directly. Kalodata is unbeatable on the depth of TikTok Shop data, with 500 days of history, but stays limited to that single ecosystem.

For most dropshippers, yes. Copyfy covers multi-platform product research, competitor analysis, AI product pages and visual import to Shopify. Kalodata keeps the edge on pure TikTok data, creators and livestreams: if pure TikTok Shop is your core business, it complements Copyfy well.
Yes, both offer a 5-day free trial. Copyfy adds a 5-day free trial. The simplest is to test Copyfy for free to see if the multi-platform suite covers your need.
